decisions.decision: Anti-livelock valve added to the engine (not in the original phase scope)
decisions.rationale: Pure greedy play livelocks ~10% of rounds at a full roster. The valve makes zero-stall a property of the engine rather than a bet on player behaviour. Valve-off twins stall 3.58-8.31% at N=10 against a 0.0116% residual.

decisions.decision: Shipped pool k=3, j=1, Wild default, 8.0s auto-pass deadline
decisions.rationale: Owner chose k=3 from the bar-sensitivity ladder over the bar's own k=6. Every candidate k=2..k=6 cleared all five bars and the firing-rate curve has no elbow, so the bar chooses rather than discovers. k=3 is the tightest pool reaching a clean zero stall rate.

decisions.decision: G1's literal zero-stall bar replaced by a 0.500% residual ceiling
decisions.rationale: No pool this engine has reaches literal zero. Owner-approved, dated, with the measured residual (37 in 320,000) printed everywhere rather than rounded away. evaluateBars was not relaxed and still fails in 20 of 32 gated cells in the committed artefact.

decisions.decision: CI suite accepted at ~25s against CONTEXT's locked ~20s
decisions.rationale: Owner accepted the overshoot. Nothing trimmed to meet it: the 500-round floor, every mutation case and every bar are intact.
xorshift32 returned 1 for every seed 1..1000 on its first draw. Fisher-Yates spends its first draw on the last position, so every deal and every seeded trial would have been biased identically.
